sources.title: RolmOCR: Document OCR Model for Recognizing Handwritten and Slanted ...
sources.snippet: RolmOCR is an open source OCR tool to quickly extract text from images and PDFs , built on the Qwen2.5-VL-7B model , no dependence on metadata , low memory footprint , support for handwritten and skewed documents , free for users to use and modify .
